annotations.title: Add a post to a collection

description:
Append a post to one of your collections, with an optional note on why
    it belongs there.

    The note is the part that makes a collection worth more than a list of
    links — say what the reader gets from this one.

    A post you cannot read reads as not found, so a collection can never
    publish something past its own read gate. A post already in the collection
    is a CONFLICT.

collection_id.description: The collection's UUID. Must be yours.
collection_id.title: Collection Id

note.description: Curator's note — why this post is in this list. Shown beside it.
note.title: Note
